info.name: Apifreaks Api Hub For Developers PDF Upload and Download APIs API

params.name: resource_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the file or ZIP archive to download.

items.docs: This API downloads PDF files or ZIP archives from the server using their unique resource ID.

info.name: Upload a PDF in binary format

params.name: format
params.description: Specifies the desired format for the API response. Choose 'json' for a JSON object or 'xml' for an XML structure.

params.name: file_name
params.description:
The desired name for the uploaded PDF file. This name will be used for storage on the server.


 **NOTE**: Please ensure file_name has extension `.pdf`.

items.docs: This API uploads PDF files to the API Freaks server in binary format.

info.name: Upload multiple PDFs and get file IDs

params.name: format
params.description: Specifies the desired format for the API response. Choose 'json' for a JSON object or 'xml' for an XML structure.

items.docs: This API uploads multiple PDF files to the API Freaks server and generates their unique file IDs.
